chunks: And those who say: "O Lord, give us from our spouses and our children the comfort of our eyes, and make us leaders for the pious."

key_terms.قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ: Comfort and joy of the eyes

ai.seo_question: What do the righteous servants ask God for in Surah Al-Furqan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to highlight the spiritual and moral leadership of the Ahl al-Bayt, who serve as the ultimate 'Imams' for the Muttaqin. The term 'qurrata a'yun' (coolness of eyes) signifies deep, enduring joy derived from divine proximity, while the request for leadership underscores the continuity of prophetic guidance through the Imams.
